turns.text: Hi! This is Adriene with the Senior Resource Center — I'm calling about Medicare benefits in your area. Did I catch you at a good time?
Great! So, do you currently have Medicare?
take me off your call list permanently
Of course — I'm adding your number to our internal do-not-call list right now, and you won't hear from us again. I'm sorry for the interruption, and thank you for telling me. Have a great day.
